description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muddaragama, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510205 (23/0678)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in various villages. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and title classifications under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
